method: Both locales directly authored from Japanese in source-units.json; full own-source semantic self-review of all strings. No other-pair reading, cross-review, external translation service or summary substitution.
coverage: All seven lessons: every title, complete explanatory/example paragraph, prompt, key term and illustration alt.
semanticChecks: Human-error review includes environment, labels and layout; no blame-only or intentional-error implication.
Training and equipment/identification improvements remain distinct; attendance count is not proof of improvement.
No injury does not establish quality or schedule adequacy; classifications are not exhaustive cause lists.
Expected sequence differs from actual signal; partial identifier matches are not whole-product identity.
Focused attention and unseen rear/foot-level conditions retain environmental and work-coordination factors.
Repetition does not establish unchanged conditions; domain-specific inexperience is not universal inability.
Past experience must match present route/width; silence, nodding or lack of questions does not establish understanding.
Familiarity, prior no-failure record and majority agreement do not waive required checks.
Schedules include safety conditions; workload/personnel/order/overlap are management factors, not merely individual endurance.
Hearing differs from meaning; repeat-back differs from merely reproducing sounds and must identify scope.
One recipient or phone call does not establish all workers/relief workers informed; undated changes retain uncertainty.
Reflex/startle and panic remain separate concepts; dropping a tool is a risk example, not a recommendation.
Upper/lower simultaneous activity, tool management and personnel location retain planning scope.
Emergency contacts/roles and evacuation information change with routes; no rescue or medical procedure added.
Age alone does not determine individual capability; visibility/environment and individual condition are both considered.
Fatigue includes sleep/lifestyle and workload; management work/rest adjustment is not replaced by demands for willpower or sleep alone.
Unusual fatigue and health concerns go to appropriate source-specified reporting channels; no diagnosis inferred.
